comparison.objective: Support a partly open garage door, release its opener, and lower it under control; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting and lowering a large articulated load while pulling a release differs from small-tool engagement, collar adjustment, relocking, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Title establishes controlled lowering, but the record omits speed, force, closure, and damage thresholds; candidate has quantified impact and retention checks.
comparison.reason: Shared force control is generic; the mechanisms and tested outcomes differ.
